dossier.scp_unleashed.018.title: Super Ball
dossier.scp_unleashed.018.caption: SCP-018 at intake, at rest beside its evidence tag.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-018 is kept in a padded storage container in a low-traffic wing. The container is opened only for approved testing. **SCP-018 is never to be thrown inside a closed room.**

Testing takes place outdoors, on open ground, with all observers well back from the throw. A trained catcher stands by. Once SCP-018 is too fast to catch safely, staff are to leave the area and let it run its course.
After a test, SCP-018 is to be recovered from the test site at once and returned to its container.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-018 is a red rubber ball about the size of a fist, of the kind sold as a super ball. Apart from its colour it carries no markings. Its surface cannot be cut, burnt or punctured by any means tried so far.

Every time SCP-018 strikes a surface, it rebounds a little faster than it arrived. Each bounce adds about one percent to its speed. Thrown inside a closed room, it bounces from wall to wall faster and faster, and within seconds becomes hard to follow by eye.

Above about 36 m/s, SCP-018 injures anything it strikes, and the faster it travels the more harm it does. At about 100 m/s it bursts in a blast comparable to a small explosive charge. SCP-018 itself is always recovered from the site of the blast, intact and at rest.
A slow SCP-018 can be caught by hand. It does not resist.

page.title: Addendum 018-1: Test Log
text: Test 018-02: dropped from waist height onto concrete in an open yard. It rose a little higher with every bounce and was caught by hand after twelve bounces.
Test 018-05: thrown underarm into a 4 m test cell. The door was shut after it. Bursting took about twelve seconds. The cell was destroyed. SCP-018 was found on the floor of the crater.
Test 018-09: thrown hard across an open field. It climbed out of sight after a few bounces and came down far beyond the perimeter. %rIt was recovered two days later.%r

page.title: Addendum 018-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-018 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file by an unidentified individual in a striped ringmaster's coat and a top hat, who described it as a free gift. The individual is not the figure in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The individual named a toy maker, %rDr. Wondertainment%r, and would not stop smiling. See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp018_ball.tooltip: A small red rubber ball. It never loses a bounce.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp018_ball.1: SCP-018 is a small red rubber ball that speeds up a little every time it bounces. Use it to throw it, or sneak-use it for a gentle toss.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp018_ball.2: While it is slow you can catch it by walking into it or using it. Above 36 blocks per second it hurts whatever it strikes, and the faster it goes the harder it hits.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp018_ball.3: At 100 blocks per second it bursts in an explosion and the ball drops to the ground, unharmed. If it would fly into unloaded land, it drops as an item instead.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp018_ball.4: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-018 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A few minutes later a cheerful stranger in a top hat delivers the ball.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp018.0: Not the courier from other files. This one wears a top hat.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp018.1: Meet it out in the open, well away from walls.
